title: TinyViT-5M at 90 MHz — matched pipeline timing
status: Measured on DE1-SoC; warm full-forward means and separate first-forward profile
description: 224×224 input; batch one; two Cortex-A9 threads; same 20 uniform-random RGB input hashes for all three pipelines. Warm timing follows one untimed forward. The component breakdown is from separate profiled first forwards and should not be summed to infer the warm mean. Top-1 counts use the same 200 labeled images. The supplied overview image summarizes the architecture and offload path.
imageAlt: TinyViT-5M CPU and CPU–FPGA latency comparison, model architecture, offloaded blocks and static-weight operation count
imageCaption: TinyViT-5M offload overview supplied by Stephanie. Open image for full resolution.
